picks.title: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 5 for both AI coding and general office work
picks.excerpt: Anthropic's new frontier model Claude Opus 5 is a cheaper, stronger model for coding and agents — the class of model that now powers AI design tools like Claude Design, Cursor, Lovable and Figma Make, so its release ripples directly into designers' AI workflows.
picks.rationale: A cheaper/stronger frontier model is the engine under Claude Design, Cursor, Lovable and Figma Make — it upgrades the design-to-code stack designers touch daily; reputable source, high novelty.

picks.title: I turned a photo of my handwriting into a real font, then open-sourced the whole pipeline
picks.excerpt: A designer photographed a single page of handwritten letters in dim light and ran an open-sourced pipeline that outputs an installable TTF — a hands-on look at AI-assisted type design and how far automated font generation has come.
picks.rationale: A reproducible, open-sourced photo-to-TTF pipeline puts AI type design in reach of any designer — concrete, novel, and immediately runnable.

picks.title: Character Consistency Across 24 Pages of a Generated Picture Book
picks.excerpt: Generating one AI illustration of a child from a reference photo is easy now; keeping that same character consistent across 24 pages is the hard part. A practical walkthrough of character-consistency techniques for generative illustration and design workflows.
picks.rationale: Character consistency is the real blocker in production generative illustration — a hands-on technique walkthrough a design team can apply tomorrow.
